children: Integra announced pricing of $450 million 9.500% senior secured notes due 2033, part of a broader debt refinancing.
Priced $450,000,000 aggregate principal of 9.500% senior secured notes due 2033 in a private placement.
Notes are general senior secured obligations, guaranteed by the Company’s wholly-owned domestic guarantor subsidiaries.
Sale expected to close on or about October 19, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Net proceeds plus borrowings under a new credit facility will refinance existing credit facilities and pay related fees and expenses.
Company expects the refinancing to raise its effective interest rate near the high end of the previously communicated 100–200 bps increase.
